title: agropyron junceum subsp. obtusiflorum
intro: Agropyron junceum subsp. obtusiflorum, commonly known as meadow barley, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat conditions such as digestive issues and inflammation due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of meadow barley include its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
